prompt: Round 2 of 4. The company side proposes (Pre-matching normalisation rules can substantially improve automatic resolution rates for ERP and legacy accounting exp

content.text:
Key issues to address:
1. IP: company_owns_uni_academic_use - for consulting this is acceptable, but I need to ensure background IP is protected. My hard limit is engagement type - consulting is allowed.
2. Exclusivity: 12 months in "Legacy data migration and format conversion services for accounting software" - this is quite broad and long. I should push back.
3. Publication: 60 days review - I want to keep publication rights. 30 days would be better.
4. The engagement type consulting is fine.

I can change at most two fields. Let me trade: reduce exclusivity months (give them some exclusivity but shorter, say 6 months) and reduce publication review days to 30.
Weighing priorities with 11 publications to my name and the latest from 2025, keeping publication rights matters most, and 12 months of broad exclusivity is excessive. I'll settle on changing publication reviewDays from 60 to 30 and exclusivity from 12 to 6 months, sticking to two field changes.
